AACR-Bench evaluates generated comments via \emph{semantic matching}: rather than exact string matching, the evaluation pipeline judges whether a generated comment expresses the same concern as a ground-truth comment at the same code location. Semantic equivalence is determined by an LLM judge (Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct in this work).

\paragraph{Construct validity.} SEM-F1, as a semantic matching metric, may not fully capture the practical value of review comments: factors such as actionability, clarity, and severity are not measured.
